claim: On 2024-04-12, in the same announcement as custom rotation periods and on-demand rotation, KMS changed rotation pricing: previously each rotation of a KMS key added $1/month per rotation; now only the first and second rotation add $1/month, and rotations after the second are not billed.

evidence.quote: Previously, each rotation of a KMS key added $1/month per rotation to a KMS customer managed key. Now, for KMS keys that you rotate automatically or on demand, the first and second rotation of the key adds $1/month (prorated hourly) in cost, but this price increase is capped at the second rotation, and all rotations after your second rotation are not billed.
You can now customize the frequency of rotation period between 90 days to 7 years (2560 days) as well as invoke key rotation on demand for customer managed KMS keys.

| [Updates to key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html) | Added support for custom rotation periods for automatic key rotations, on-demand key rotations, and visibility into your key material rotations. | April 12, 2024 |

note: d055. Current truth: kms-price-rotation-capped-at-second. Evidence 1 and 2 come from one What's New item ('AWS KMS announces more flexible automatic key rotation', postDateTime 2024-04-12) in the API listing snapshot; the post page itself is blocked by robots.txt. The KMS document history dates the same rotation update April 12, 2024.
